payload.entry: Progress: mount-race fix + 2 regression tests in (22/22 modal tests pass, failed pre-fix as designed); mini-macro location PNG tests host-isolated with refreshed inspected goldens (clean --check normal + TZ=UTC); snippet goldens unchanged (clean both zones); flaky action tests 20/20 serial, 3x18 under -n8; tui_screenshot.md host-independent rule added + memory init republished. Awaiting sase tool run check 89aad8e23117df927549f19814d4c3ae.

PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: timeband_past_light_120x40 lost the body-top ─ row — after pinning chrome age to 7d, light 120x40 past heading sits at y=93.2 while past_dark_120x40 and past_light_60x30 keep the ─ separator and heading at y=117.6; capture and verify SHA matched (14431b49), so it is stable theme-layout drift, not a flake. Age token 7d is correct.

Fixed the timeband chrome-rule flake that note #1 recorded as PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP. Cause: _update_trail re-showed #pager-chrome-rule after _update_subject hid it, and _update_time_band returned early on a matching signature without restoring the hide. Signature-matching paints now re-sync the rule; trail hide uses the same helper. Unit test test_time_band_signature_match_keeps_chrome_rule_hidden. Applied 11 remaining timeband goldens (rule gone while the band shows). Host-independence --check clean locally and with TZ=UTC: status=clean created=0 updated=0 stale=0 unchanged=62 (runs 6b14d629 and 882e745a).

PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: test_tui_app_import_stays_under_startup_budget fails identically on clean base tree (loads 3516 modules vs 3513 cap, no phase files involved); check run 89aad8e23117df927549f19814d4c3ae also showed KNOWN global-state-leak, FLAKY view-leak, and a zsh-smoke pty timeout, all outside phase scope
